findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_custody_schedule · Private data: make_custody_schedule · Public sink: make_custody_schedule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_custody_schedule · Private data: make_custody_schedule · Public sink: make_custody_schedule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "add_holiday_rotation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
